description: A rule alternates `.A(x) | .B` on the from side — one alternative binds, the other does not. Per §51.3.2 the binding sets must match across alternatives, so the mismatch is rejected with E-ENGINE-016 (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.3.2 — `|` alternation expands one rule line into several. If the alternatives on a side bind different name sets, the expanded rules would put different names in scope depending on which alternative matched, so the rule body could not be written against a stable binding set. Either every alternative on a side binds the same names, or none bind.
